name: Yurushite ~Yuuki Hitomi no Baai~
original_name: ゆ・る・し・て～結城瞳の場合～
source:
Two girls explore a newly inherited mansion. However, mysterious powers deviating from common sense swirl inside the mansion. Main character is to pursue the escaping girls in the maze of the mansion and insult them vigorously.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
两个女孩探索一座新继承的豪宅。然而，宅邸内却蕴藏着违背常理的神秘力量。主角在宅邸的迷宫中追击逃跑的少女，并大力辱骂她们。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
